comment.body: Thanks for the new result: pairing with an existing key after changing one endpoint version is distinct from being able to generate a new key or update settings. #51789 is still the open, unmerged candidate for the signer-verification failure already evidenced here. Its validation should cover New key, connecting with an existing key, and Use Service both off and on with consistent signed builds on both endpoints. This report does not establish that a preview, downgrade, or mixed-version executable replacement is an official general fix; no repeat firewall checklist is needed.
